info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Linarite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Linarite Battery Details Management API enables users to create and manage detailed information about Linarite batteries. This endpoint focuses on adding new records to the catalog, capturing essential specifications and features that define each battery model. Typical consumers of this API include inventory management systems and product catalog platforms looking to maintain up-to-date and accurate battery details. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their offerings and improve customer experiences through rich product information.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Linarite battery, enabling efficient management of battery-related information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit the details of a Linarite battery. It must adhere to the specified JSON schema for successful processing.

200.description: The request was successful, and the details of the Linarite battery have been returned.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Linarite battery.

supplier.description: The supplier details for the Linarite battery.
